name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches 'Never pick up the box'; the soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' (key_lost is already the door-closed event, so a plain Absence is right); and the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later', with 'try to' making all non-hard clauses soft. The rule-only warning is valid: no event is commanded unconditionally and hard.

Whenever the agent holds the matching key, try to have the door open then or open it later.
